d02_s4: A modern Black man in his 30s on a couch at night watches his phone buzz with an incoming call labeled only by a photo of his younger brother, and he turns the phone over and ignores it.
d02_s5: The same modern man knocks on his younger brother's apartment door at night; the door opens and the two brothers embrace tightly in the doorway, warm hallway light.
d03_s1: an older man with weathered brown skin and a long gray-streaked beard, long deep-blue wool robe with a woven border, ochre sash, leather sandals hammers a huge wooden beam on the side of an enormous unfinished ark under heavy storm clouds, while villagers in the distance point and laugh.
d03_s2: Pairs of animals, elephants, lions, sheep and doves, walking calmly up a wide wooden ramp into the ark, while an older woman with brown skin, gray-streaked hair under a fine cream linen head covering, long madder-red robe with a woven border, embroidered sash watches with wonder and first raindrops begin to fall.
d03_s3: After the flood, the ark rests on a green mountainside under clearing skies; an older man with weathered brown skin and a long gray-streaked beard, long deep-blue wool robe with a woven border, ochre sash, leather sandals and an older woman with brown skin, gray-streaked hair under a fine cream linen head covering, long madder-red robe with a woven border, embroidered sash stand together looking up as a brilliant rainbow arcs across the sky.
d03_s4: A modern Black woman in her 40s keeps working late at night on a sewing machine in a small home workshop full of fabric, while relatives on the couch behind her shake their heads doubtfully.
d03_s5: The same modern woman opens the doors of her own small boutique on a sunny morning, customers walking in, and she looks up and smiles as a rainbow sign glows in the window.
d04_s1: Thousands of ancient workers in finely woven tunics haul mud bricks up the ramps of a towering half-built ziggurat tower in a Mesopotamian plain at sunset, dust in the air, epic wide shot.
d04_s2: At dawn outside a mud-brick city, a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band, leather sandals, wooden staff kneels alone on a rooftop, looking out toward the horizon as a warm wind lifts his robe and head covering.
d04_s3: A long caravan of camels, donkeys and flocks moves across a golden desert road; a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band, leather sandals, wooden staff walks at the front beside a graceful woman about 65 with warm brown skin, silver-streaked dark hair under a fine indigo linen veil, long cream robe with a saffron embroidered border, gold-thread sash, with a man about 40 with olive-brown skin, short black beard, ochre wool tunic with a dark border, brown mantle behind them, all in dignified ancient Mesopotamian/Canaanite clothing, finely woven, modest, nothing torn or ragged.
d04_s4: A modern young Black couple loads the last boxes into a small moving truck in front of their old house at sunrise, the wife hesitating and looking back, the husband taking her hand.
d04_s5: The same modern couple drives on an open highway at golden hour, the wife resting her head on his shoulder, a long road ahead and a bright sky.
d05_s1: Night in the desert: a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band, leather sandals, wooden staff stands outside his goat-hair tent, head tilted back, looking up at a sky blazing with countless stars, the Milky Way stretching overhead.
d05_s2: In a dry wilderness, a young Egyptian woman about 25 with deep brown skin, black braided hair under a white linen head wrap, fine white linen dress with a blue woven collar sits alone beside a small spring of water, exhausted and weeping, when a soft beam of warm light falls on her and she looks up in awe.
d05_s3: a young Egyptian woman about 25 with deep brown skin, black braided hair under a white linen head wrap, fine white linen dress with a blue woven collar rises by the spring with tears on her face and a look of peace, hand over her heart, golden light around her.
d05_s4: A modern Black single mother in scrubs sits alone in her car in a hospital parking lot at night, head on the steering wheel, exhausted, rain on the windshield.
d05_s5: The same modern mother looks up as the rain stops and morning sunlight breaks through the windshield onto her face; she wipes her tears and smiles softly.
d06_s1: In the heat of the day a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band, leather sandals, wooden staff bows low before three mysterious travelers in white robes at the entrance of his tent under a great oak tree, offering bread and water.
d06_s2: Inside the tent door, a graceful woman about 65 with warm brown skin, silver-streaked dark hair under a fine indigo linen veil, long cream robe with a saffron embroidered border, gold-thread sash listens behind the curtain and laughs quietly to herself in disbelief, hand over her mouth, eyes bright.
d06_s3: At dawn a man about 40 with olive-brown skin, short black beard, ochre wool tunic with a dark border, brown mantle hurries his wife and two daughters out of a city gate onto a hillside path, urging them forward, the sky behind them glowing orange; one woman slows and begins to turn her head.
d06_s4: A modern Black woman in her 50s laughs and shakes her head in disbelief while reading a letter at her kitchen table, then the laugh turns into tears of hope.
d06_s5: The same modern woman stands at the front of a church in a graduation cap and gown, holding a diploma high as her family cheers.
d07_s1: a graceful very old woman with warm brown skin, silver hair under a fine indigo linen veil, long cream robe with a saffron embroidered border, gold-thread sash, holds a newborn baby in soft cream swaddling inside a lamp-lit tent and laughs with joy, tears on her cheeks, as a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band looks on beaming.
d07_s2: a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band, leather sandals, wooden staff and a boy about 13 with warm brown skin and short curly black hair, cream wool tunic with a saffron border climb a rocky mountain path together at morning; the boy carries a bundle of firewood on his back and looks up at his father.
d07_s3: On the mountaintop a strong man about 75 with warm brown skin, long gray-and-black beard, kind deep-set eyes, long saffron wool robe with a woven red-and-indigo border, cream linen head covering with a cord band, leather sandals, wooden staff turns at a sound and sees a ram caught by its horns in a thicket, golden light streaming down; the boy stands safe beside him, both in awe.
d07_s4: A modern Black father and his teenage son sit at a kitchen table at night looking over a pile of unpaid bills; the son looks up worried and the father puts a hand on his shoulder.
d07_s5: The same modern father opens an envelope at the mailbox the next morning, reads it, and closes his eyes in gratitude as his son runs up to hug him.
d08_s1: At an ancient stone well outside a town at evening, a young woman about 20 with light brown skin, long wavy dark hair partly under a saffron veil, madder-red linen dress with a woven border, bronze bracelets lowers a clay water jar, then pours water into a trough for ten thirsty camels while an older steward about 60 with brown skin and a short gray beard, brown wool robe with a tan border watches amazed.
d08_s2: In a field at sunset, a man about 40 with warm brown skin, short black curly beard, quiet eyes, olive linen robe with a cream border walks in thought; on a camel in the distance a young woman about 20 with light brown skin, long wavy dark hair partly under a saffron veil, madder-red linen dress with a woven border, bronze bracelets sees him and draws her veil over her face.
d08_s3: Inside a tent, a man about 25 with ruddy reddish-brown skin, thick reddish hair and beard, hairy forearms, leather hunting vest over a rust wool tunic, bow over his shoulder bursts in exhausted from hunting and stares hungrily at a pot of red lentil stew that a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, thoughtful eyes, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle is stirring over a fire.
d08_s4: A modern young Black man in his 20s, tired and frustrated, signs a payday loan contract at a store counter under harsh fluorescent light without reading it.
d08_s5: The same modern young man stands outside the store at night staring at the contract in his hand, regret on his face, then folds it and looks up thoughtfully.
d09_s1: a man about 40 with warm brown skin, short black curly beard, quiet eyes, olive linen robe with a cream border and his servants dig a new well in a dry valley and cheer as fresh water bubbles up, sunlight sparkling on it.
d09_s2: In a lamp-lit tent, a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, thoughtful eyes, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle, with goatskins wrapped on his hands and neck, kneels nervously beside a very old man with a long white beard and cloudy blind eyes, cream robe, resting on a cushioned couch inside a lamp-lit goat-hair tent, who reaches out to feel his hands.
d09_s3: a man about 25 with ruddy reddish-brown skin, thick reddish hair and beard, hairy forearms, leather hunting vest over a rust wool tunic kneels beside a very old man with a long white beard and cloudy blind eyes, cream robe, resting on a cushioned couch inside a lamp-lit goat-hair tent and cries out bitterly, tears running down his face, hands raised.
d09_s4: A modern Black family dinner: two adult brothers argue across the table while their elderly father sits between them, hurt and silent.
d09_s5: The same modern brothers sit on the porch steps at night, one offering the other a cup of coffee; they sit in silence, then one puts his arm around the other.
d10_s1: Night in a rocky wilderness: a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, thoughtful eyes, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle lies asleep with his head on a stone, and in a glowing vision above him a vast golden stairway of light rises into the stars with shining figures ascending and descending.
d10_s2: At sunrise a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, thoughtful eyes, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle stands beside a tall upright stone pillar, pouring oil over it from a horn, trembling with awe.
d10_s3: At a stone well surrounded by flocks of sheep, a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, thoughtful eyes, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle rolls a heavy stone off the well's mouth as a beautiful young woman about 18 with light olive skin, long dark braid, sky-blue linen dress with a white woven border arrives with her sheep; their eyes meet.
d10_s4: A modern Black man in his 30s sleeps sitting up in a hard plastic chair in a hospital waiting room at night, alone, a jacket over him.
d10_s5: The same modern man wakes at dawn as a nurse touches his shoulder and smiles with good news; he stands and covers his mouth with relief.
d11_s1: a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, thoughtful eyes, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle, shepherd's staff tends large flocks of speckled and spotted goats and sheep at a watering trough at sunrise.
d11_s2: At night a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle leads his wives, children and flocks quietly across a river by moonlight, looking back over his shoulder.
d11_s3: On a hill a man about 60 with olive skin, a sly smile, long black-and-gray beard, rich purple wool robe with a gold-thread border and a man about 30 with olive-brown skin, neat short black beard, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle stand on either side of a heap of stones they have piled together, facing each other warily as the sun sets.
d11_s4: Two modern Black women in their 30s, former best friends, pass each other in a grocery aisle and both look away awkwardly.
d11_s5: The same two modern women sit across a small cafe table, one sliding a note across; they nod respectfully and part in peace.
d12_s1: Night by a rushing stream: a man about 55 with olive-brown skin, black beard streaked with gray, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle wrestles with a mysterious man whose face is hidden in shadow and light, the two locked together, struggling in the dark at the first light of dawn.
d12_s2: At sunrise a man about 55 with olive-brown skin, black beard streaked with gray, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle, shepherd's staff limps alone across a shallow stream, face shining, as the sun rises behind him.
d12_s3: In an open field a man about 55 with ruddy reddish-brown skin, thick reddish-gray hair and beard, leather vest over a rust wool tunic throws his arms around a man about 55 with olive-brown skin, black beard streaked with gray, indigo wool tunic with a cream border, striped mantle; both brothers weep as they embrace.
d12_s4: A modern Black woman kneels on her bedroom floor at 3 AM by the bed, praying hard with tears, a single lamp on.
d12_s5: The same modern woman opens her curtains at sunrise, light filling the room, and smiles with tired peace.
d13_s1: a young man of 17 with warm brown skin and short curly black hair, wearing a long-sleeved ankle-length coat of many colours woven in bright stripes of red, blue, gold and green walks proudly across a field toward a group of rough older shepherd brothers in earth-toned wool tunics, who glare at him with jealousy.
d13_s2: a young man of 17 with warm brown skin and short curly black hair, wearing a long-sleeved ankle-length coat of many colours woven in bright stripes of red, blue, gold and green sits at a night campfire telling his dream with bright eyes while his older brothers in earth-toned tunics scowl.
d13_s3: Rough shepherd brothers in earth-toned wool tunics stand at the edge of a dry pit in the desert, one holding a torn striped coat of many colours, as a camel caravan of traders approaches in the distance.
d13_s4: A modern Black teenage boy shows his excited drawings of a dream business at a family dinner while his older siblings roll their eyes.
d13_s5: The same modern teen sits alone on his bedroom floor, hurt, then picks up his sketchbook and keeps drawing with determination.
d14_s1: In a grand Egyptian house with painted columns, a young man about 25 with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a full white linen Egyptian tunic with long sleeves and a wide beaded collar oversees servants and scrolls with quiet confidence as an Egyptian official nods approvingly.
d14_s2: a young man about 25 with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a full white linen Egyptian tunic with long sleeves and a wide beaded collar runs down an Egyptian hallway in a hurry, glancing back, an empty white linen cloak lying on the floor behind him.
d14_s3: In a torch-lit Egyptian stone prison, a young man about 25 with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a full white linen Egyptian tunic with long sleeves and a wide beaded collar sits with two worried prisoners, a royal butler and a baker, listening to their dreams.
d14_s4: A modern young Black man in a business suit at an office after hours closes his laptop, stands up and walks out of a room where a coworker is pressuring him.
d14_s5: The same modern young man walks out of the office building into morning sunlight, head high, and calls his mother smiling.
